_doc: Machine-readable hardware-decode integration test matrix. Prose, rationale and success criteria live in docs/hardware-decode/integration-test-matrix.md; this file is the executable half. `python -m tests.hwdecode.harness check-matrix` asserts the two agree on IDs and severities.

repeat_policy.note: P0 correctness tests need 3 independent runs; performance tests report mean/min/max over 3 runs. Long-run needs 1 clean full pass.

tests.title: NVEncC identity
tests.expected: sha256, version string and patch sha256 all match the recorded provenance
tests.verification: sha256 binary + parse --version + cross-check provenance json

tests.title: QSVEncC identity
tests.expected: sha256, version string and patch sha256 all match; version-boundary claim recorded
tests.verification: same as A-01 plus the pinned-8.26 claim text

tests.title: Runtime backend identity
tests.expected: Input Info prints the hardware reader (avcuvid / avqsv), never avsw
tests.verification: parse Input Info from the raw tool log

tests.title: Software control identity
tests.expected: Input Info prints avsw for both tools
tests.verification: parse Input Info from the raw tool log

tests.title: Stock control exists and differs
tests.expected: stock binary present, runnable, hash different from patched, version string different
tests.verification: sha256 + --version on both

tests.title: Toolchain never resolved from PATH
tests.expected: resolved path unchanged with a decoy of the same name earlier on PATH
tests.verification: plant a decoy NVEncC64.exe in a temp dir prepended to PATH; re-run hash check

tests.title: Missing runtime classified as startup failure
tests.expected: non-zero exit, classified as startup/reader failure, not as integrity failure
tests.verification: run the stripped copy and classify its log

tests.title: Provenance self-check gates the run
tests.expected: verify_provenance raises when any hash or version token mismatches
tests.verification: run verify_provenance twice, then with a deliberately wrong expectation

tests.title: Default tool resolution excludes the research builds
tests.expected: find_hw_tool returns the shipped build deterministically; tools/avhw is never selected by a glob
tests.verification: resolve both tool names and assert the shipped path plus the exclusion rule

tests.title: Sony XAVC HS routing
tests.expected: both eligible; auto selects avhw; reason=proven_combination; real run prints hardware reader
tests.verification: route_decode decision + one real encode + reader identity

tests.title: Sony H.264 4:2:2 routing diverges by backend
tests.expected: nvenc eligible (avhw); qsv capability_refused -> software; outputs frame-exact either way
tests.verification: route_decode for both backends + real encode on the software side

tests.title: DJI routing
tests.expected: both eligible
tests.verification: route_decode decisions

tests.title: Unknown input takes the safe decision
tests.expected: not_proven -> software; never 'unknown -> hardware anyway'
tests.verification: route_decode over a grid of unproven combinations

tests.title: Default policy is unchanged behaviour
tests.expected: policy=off yields the identical argv the pre-integration code produced (leading --avsw)
tests.verification: build argv with default reader and diff token-by-token against the literal

tests.title: require never silently degrades
tests.expected: reason=require_unmet and the caller raises; no software pass
tests.verification: route_decode + the ladder's require handling

tests.title: VFR interacts correctly with reader choice
tests.expected: reader choice and --avsync forcecfr are independent; both appear when both apply
tests.verification: build argv with vfr=True and reader=avhw

tests.title: Routing is deterministic and auditable
tests.expected: identical decisions across repeated calls; decision line carries reason code
tests.verification: call route_decode twice over the grid and compare serialised JSON

tests.title: Refusal and frame loss are distinguishable
tests.input: synthetic logs of each failure class
tests.expected: capability_refused / device_unavailable / reader_unavailable / decode_failed / count_mismatch / sequence_mismatch all distinct
tests.verification: classify_reader_failure on each real/synthetic log fragment; assert distinct codes

tests.title: Hardware decode is pinned to the verified build
tests.expected: policy off -> no decode-tool override; policy auto/require -> the patched build by sha256; a missing or mismatched build yields a reason code instead of a silent fallback to the shipped build
tests.verification: resolve_decode_tool across policies plus a corrupted-copy negative

tests.title: Sony short: stock vs patched vs software
tests.expected: patched avhw == avsw on counts, sequence, PTS, keyframes; stock reproduces N-3 and is recorded as the known-defect control
tests.verification: three encodes + six-source reconciliation + ordered fingerprint

tests.title: Sony medium: totals, fingerprint, PTS, keyframes
tests.expected: full equality of count, ordered fingerprint, PTS sequence and keyframe index sequence
tests.verification: hw vs sw encodes + packet manifest + fingerprint

tests.title: Sony long: no silent loss, no duplication
tests.expected: every completed run reconciles at container; an out-of-range request clamps loudly to EOF
tests.verification: long sweep + reconciliation

tests.title: Sony real corpus: fixture correctness transfers
tests.input: sony_hs + 12 real_a7m5 clips across the size range
tests.expected: avhw == container on every clip with matching fingerprint
tests.verification: batch scan with per-clip reconciliation and fingerprint

tests.title: DJI short/medium/long exactness
tests.expected: exact; the patches must not change the leading=0 controls
tests.verification: hw vs sw encodes + reconciliation + fingerprint

tests.title: H.264 4:2:2: hardware exact (NVENC) / refusal (QSV)
tests.expected: nvenc avhw output equals avsw; qsv refuses loudly with rc!=0 and no output
tests.verification: per-backend encode + assertions

tests.title: Control codecs are unaffected
tests.expected: auto and off agree; no wrong activation; MKV decision explicit
tests.verification: two encodes per fixture (auto and off) + reconciliation

tests.title: Six-source reconciliation is complete
tests.expected: every count field present and non-null; reader self-report recorded but never the reference
tests.verification: field-completeness scan over all C results

tests.title: Negative: injected head loss is detected
tests.input: stock NVEncC avhw on sony_hs (real N-3)
tests.expected: gate FAILS with count_mismatch, discards the artifact, reruns software and delivers exact output
tests.verification: run the real stock binary through the production gate

tests.title: Negative: count-preserving corruption is detected
tests.expected: count gate passes it by construction; sequence gate catches it with sequence_mismatch
tests.verification: feed a count-preserving wrong artifact to both gate levels

tests.title: Negative: bad result never delivered
tests.expected: hardware artifact deleted, software rerun delivers the exact result, all three log stages present
tests.verification: end-to-end injected scenario + delivered hash

tests.title: Negative: tail truncation is detected
tests.expected: count gate catches a short tail as well as a short head
tests.verification: feed a tail-truncated artifact to the count gate

tests.title: Byte identity on suitable controls
tests.expected: avhw and avsw output hashes identical where the research observed byte identity
tests.verification: same-settings encodes + sha256

tests.title: Full decode
tests.expected: hw and sw equal frame-for-frame with no seek or trim
tests.verification: reconciliation + fingerprint

tests.title: Start seek at four positions
tests.expected: hw and sw agree on frame sequence, PTS, first frame and duration at every position
tests.verification: paired encodes per position + packet manifest compare

tests.title: Trim: head / middle / near-end
tests.expected: hw and sw agree on all trim shapes
tests.verification: paired encodes per trim + compare

tests.title: Repeated seek across positions
tests.expected: output frame sequence, PTS, first frame and duration identical at every position
tests.verification: parametric sweep

tests.title: Hardware vs software on all seek/trim cases
tests.expected: content equality on every case, not merely both succeeding
tests.verification: aggregate of the seek/trim comparisons

tests.title: Explicit --seek 0 boundary
tests.expected: the seek-0 edge is a measured fact, not an unobserved assumption
tests.verification: explicit --seek 0 vs no seek, compared

tests.title: --frames N matrix
tests.expected: requested vs presented recorded for avhw, avsw and stock avhw
tests.verification: parametric sweep producing the contract table

tests.title: --frames contract is explicit
tests.expected: per-N contract table; shortfall is not lumped into one 'bug'; full-input integrity is unaffected
tests.verification: contract table generation and assertion of the leading-picture relation

tests.title: --trim semantics recorded separately
tests.expected: trim shortfall recorded independently of the --frames contract
tests.verification: trim sweep with presented counts

tests.title: Resolution, SAR, DAR
tests.expected: 3840x2160 preserved with 1:1 SAR and 16:9 DAR under both readers
tests.verification: ffprobe field comparison hw vs sw

tests.title: Bit depth
tests.expected: 10-bit stays 10-bit under hardware decode
tests.verification: pix_fmt comparison

tests.title: Chroma
tests.expected: 4:2:0 stays 4:2:0; 4:2:2 kept where supported; any conversion announced
tests.verification: pix_fmt comparison + downgrade-record assertion

tests.title: Colour metadata
tests.expected: range/colorspace/primaries/transfer identical to the software result
tests.verification: ffprobe colour field comparison

tests.title: Frame timing
tests.expected: PTS strictly monotonic, duration and frame interval match software, no timestamp shift
tests.verification: full PTS sequence + monotonicity + duration

tests.title: No GPAC colr regression
tests.expected: video-track colr box matches the source field-for-field
tests.verification: parse stsd/colr with the project ISO-BMF reader

tests.title: Container-level preservation unchanged
tests.expected: stream inventory and rtmd payload hashes match the software baseline
tests.verification: preservation run + comparison against the software baseline

tests.title: Hardware unavailable
tests.expected: clear reason code, software path, exact output
tests.verification: run with a bad device selector and classify

tests.title: Capability rejection
tests.expected: capability_refused -> software; refusal distinguished from frame loss
tests.verification: stock qsv avhw run + classification

tests.title: Startup failure
tests.expected: classified as startup/reader failure, not integrity failure; run terminates cleanly
tests.verification: launch the stripped copy and classify

tests.title: Runtime decode failure
tests.input: input the hardware reader cannot decode
tests.expected: classified and routed to software or a loud failure; never a silent partial result
tests.verification: trigger a mid-run decode failure and inspect the gate verdict

tests.title: Integrity failure discards and reruns
tests.expected: gate detects, artifact discarded, software rerun produces the exact result
tests.verification: end-to-end injected scenario (shares evidence with C-11/C-13)

tests.title: Double-fallback protection
tests.expected: bounded retries with a clear terminal condition; no unbounded hardware/software ping-pong
tests.verification: drive the ladder past the cap and assert a RuntimeError with the cap stated

tests.title: Fallback is loud
tests.expected: WARNING plus reason code in the warnings list and the per-file log; silent fallback is a P0 failure
tests.verification: inspect warnings and log text produced by a fallback run

tests.title: Fallback output equals direct software output
tests.input: post-fallback result vs plain avsw result
tests.expected: identical output hash — the fallback introduces no difference
tests.verification: sha256 of both products

tests.title: Channel-sync: already aligned
tests.expected: untouched; transparent mode byte-identical to the source
tests.verification: channel-sync decision output + hash

tests.title: Channel-sync: fixed delay correction
tests.expected: correction decision and shifted samples unchanged by the integration
tests.verification: decision JSON + output audio hash

tests.title: Channel-sync: silent/unusable track
tests.expected: that track stays untouched without blocking the others
tests.verification: per-track status comparison against the frozen baseline

tests.title: Hardware video with software audio path
tests.expected: audio result identical to the software-video run
tests.verification: audio stream hash comparison

tests.title: Hardware fallback plus audio path
tests.expected: post-fallback audio identical to the baseline
tests.verification: end-to-end injected run + audio hash

tests.title: Channel-sync frozen-baseline regression
tests.expected: the 137-segment frozen baseline is unchanged
tests.verification: run the existing regression and diff against the frozen CSV

tests.title: Colour preservation in production output
tests.expected: delivered colour metadata matches the software baseline
tests.verification: postprobe compare

tests.title: Audio preservation
tests.expected: stream count, channel count, sample rate and layout unchanged
tests.verification: ffprobe stream comparison vs baseline

tests.title: Multi-stream regression
tests.expected: delivered stream inventory matches the baseline
tests.verification: stream inventory comparison

tests.title: Resume after a successful hardware job
tests.expected: second run recognises completion and does not recompute; artifact hash unchanged
tests.verification: two consecutive preservation runs

tests.title: Resume after a fallback
tests.expected: failed-run cache does not block retry; the successful run resumes correctly
tests.verification: fail -> succeed -> resume

tests.title: Interrupted hardware job
tests.expected: no false success; state marked correctly; temporary artifacts handled per contract
tests.verification: start, terminate, inspect report and work dir

tests.title: Retry after hardware failure
tests.expected: hardware failure -> retry -> software success
tests.verification: injected scenario with stage ordering assertions

tests.title: Re-run with a stale partial artifact
tests.expected: no false resume from an incomplete artifact; the work is redone
tests.verification: plant a truncated artifact and re-run

tests.title: Single job per backend
tests.expected: each path exact on its own, measured over repeats
tests.verification: 3 independent runs each + reconciliation

tests.title: Two simultaneous hardware jobs
tests.expected: correctness holds, device selection does not cross, logs stay per-job
tests.verification: concurrent runs + product and log isolation checks

tests.title: Hardware and software together
tests.expected: contention does not produce an erroneous fallback or an integrity misjudgement
tests.verification: concurrent mixed run + verdict inspection

tests.title: Resource exhaustion
tests.expected: failure classified correctly, safe exit or fallback, no corrupted output
tests.verification: saturate then run + classification and product checks

tests.title: 4-way 4K stress (known limitation)
tests.expected: no crash, no corruption, safe exit or fallback on resource errors; throughput is recorded, not required
tests.verification: 4-way concurrent run + integrity only

tests.title: Short smoke per backend
tests.expected: all reconciling; no silent fallback
tests.verification: batch with per-clip reconciliation

tests.title: Medium matrix
tests.expected: all reconcile with matching fingerprints
tests.verification: batch

tests.title: Real Sony corpus
tests.input: >=10 short / >=10 medium / >=10 long real A7M5 clips
tests.expected: integrity holds on real footage, not just synthetic fixtures
tests.verification: batch scan + sampled fingerprints

tests.title: Real DJI corpus
tests.expected: integrity holds
tests.verification: batch

tests.title: Long run with telemetry
tests.input: one Sony long clip + one DJI long clip
tests.expected: >=1 clean full run with wall clock, CPU time, peak RSS, GPU utilisation, frame integrity and final hash recorded
tests.verification: long run with telemetry sampling

tests.title: Final matrix gate
tests.expected: machine-readable totals with P0/P1/P2 breakdown; any P0 FAIL or BLOCKED makes the final status BLOCKED
tests.verification: summary command over the results directory

tests.title: Software golden baseline
tests.expected: frame count, ordered fingerprint, PTS, duration, video and audio metadata stored per fixture
tests.verification: baseline builder over the fixture set

tests.title: Baseline is itself validated
tests.expected: >=2 independent runs agree exactly; otherwise UNSTABLE and investigated
tests.verification: repeat the baseline build and diff
